title: Please help me find my friends

classification.question_topic: Asking to find/identify other people who experienced the same recurring non-dream 'travel' to a facility/program and later portal-based dimension trips

meta.final_emotion: emotionally distressed (typing about events is 'emotionally draining'; 'traumatizing')
meta.author_theory: Not a dream; calls it 'Travel summoning or Ascension/Accession'; others think it may be astral projection

qualities.raw_description: "what looked like a hospital or research facility"; "been there so many times, I know it like the back of my hand"; "There was other kids too. A lot of kids."; staff "super nice at first"; workers were "scientists and doctors"

locations.location_name: room with an object/portal device (inside facility)

position.relative_to: inside the facility; brought into a room where there was an object

qualities.raw_description: "brought into a room where there was an object. They turned it on"; "they needed to go threw it... a portal"; staff "brought out weapons, giving us an ultimatum"

"lost on what seemed like a new planet"; "We could breathe just fine, gravity was similar"; "stranded in this dimension for almost a year"; "We lost someone there. We were injured."; described as "traumatizing"

connections.qualities: "We were brought into a room" (movement within facility)
portal device/object was "turned... on"; group was "forced into the portal" after threats; one person pushed in first, another followed
"eventually we got back" (return mechanism not described)

interactions.description: Repeated testing of children/participants: initially basic academic and morality/physical tests; later tests involving abilities (precognition/clairvoyance/telekinesis/other).

entities_involved.description: scientists/doctors/workers; used fake names; "super nice at first"; would say things were "classified" or to be learned later
"other kids too. A lot of kids"; some "failed" and "didn't come back"

interactions.description: Classes/training to prepare for tests; classes on many abilities (repeated attempts to 'awaken'); also touched on mundane topics (history/math/science, mainly science).

entities_involved.description: workers/scientists/doctors providing education and test preparation

interactions.description: Staff presented first 'assignment' to enter a portal and explore; participants refused (arguing/yelling/sobbing/crying). Staff pushed one person in; another followed; remaining were forced in after staff produced weapons and gave an ultimatum (later claimed it was a scare tactic).

entities_involved.description: facility staff/doctors/scientists; produced weapons; issued ultimatum; pushed a participant into portal
other participants (now adults) in their 20s; one pushed in; another chased after; group forced through

interactions.description: Group stranded in the other dimension for almost a year; could breathe; gravity similar; injuries occurred; one person was lost; eventually they returned.

entities_involved.description: group of participants traveling together; "We were injured"; "We lost someone there"

extraction.extraction_notes: Post describes many recurring episodes over years; specific facility layout intentionally withheld. Portal room and other-dimension segment are described, but return mechanism and detailed spatial positions (floors/directions) are not provided. Time info includes 'almost a year' stranded and lifecycle progression (childhood to 20s).
